name: delayed blast fireball
lore:
### On the Art of the Lingering Ember: *Delayed Blast Fireball*

To master *Delayed Blast Fireball* is to cradle a dying sun. Unlike the crude haste of its lesser kin, this evocation manifests as a singular, thrumming bead of incandescent orange—a pebble of pure, compressed catastrophe that sizzles with restrained kinetic fury.

To shape the Weave for this rite is to hold a scream behind your teeth. The air grows heavy with the scent of parched earth; the magic vibrates against the palms like a trapped hornet, demanding release. One must exert a terrifying degree of mental stasis, binding the inevitable explosion within a fragile shell of sheer will. 

Lore attributes its genesis to the Siege of Argentum, where the pyromancer **Elara the Patient** supposedly left a "parting gift" in the royal treasury. When the pillaging warlord finally breached the vault, he found only a flickering spark upon the cold stone. His curiosity was his final mistake.

Exercise caution, traveler: to hold such fire is to invite the conflagration to your own doorstep should your focus falter. Patience is a virtue, but in pyromancy, it is a volatile one.
